result.title: Internship - Machine Learning Research Engineer
result.letter:
Dear Perplexity team,

I am eager to contribute to machine learning research and to work on retrieval and ranking models.

I built an image classifier that fine‑tuned a pretrained ResNet18 on about 5,800 chest X‑ray images. I also created a retrieval‑augmented generation app that answers questions from PDFs, measuring retrieval hit rate and comparing two embedding models on answer quality and memory use.

Thank you for considering my application. Sincerely, Alex Example

result.title: Working Student — AI Engineering & Document Intelligence
result.letter:
Dear Tracium GmbH team, I am excited to apply for the Working Student — AI Engineering & Document Intelligence position.

The role aligns with my focus on machine learning and document intelligence, and I have hands‑on experience with Python, Git, LLMs and machine learning. My current studies in Computer Science at Example University of Applied Sciences Berlin complement the required enrolment criteria.

In Project Pneumonia X‑Ray Classifier I fine‑tuned a pretrained ResNet18 on about 5,800 chest X‑ray images, demonstrating practical model development. For the Support Ticket Classifier project I trained a TF‑IDF and logistic regression model on 20,000 tickets and served the model through a FastAPI endpoint in a Docker container. As a Working Student at Example Retail GmbH I built Python ETL scripts that load weekly sales data into PostgreSQL and automated a weekly sales report for the team.

I look forward to contributing to Tracium’s document processing workflows and sharing clear findings in English. Sincerely, Alex Example
